roborock-device.name: roborock device
roborock-device.tipAccount: Sign in on the roborock account node and click Done, then pick the vacuum here. No deploy is needed in between.
roborock-device.tipKey: IP, DUID, local key and model are stored as credentials and are not part of an exported flow.
roborock-device.tipProtocol: Auto uses the version that worked last time and tries the other one if needed. Some models answer only L01 on the LAN even when the cloud says 1.0.
roborock-device.tipDiscover: Find on LAN listens for about 8 seconds on UDP 58866. If nothing is heard, type the IP. If the port is busy, another app on this host is using it.
roborock-device.tipMaps: Reload re-reads the rooms of the loaded floor. Load this map switches the robot to that floor, reads its rooms and keeps them. Rooms appear once they have been named in the Roborock app.
roborock-device.partial: Could not read rooms for the loaded map. Floors are still listed. __error__
roborock-device.confirmLoad: Load "__name__" (map __flag__) on the robot? This changes the active floor.
roborock-device.unconfirmed: The robot was asked to load map __flag__, but its status still shows another floor.
roborock-device.confirmBack: Rooms saved for "__name__". Switch back to "__prev__" (map __flag__)?
roborock-device.selected: Selected __name__. Click Done, then Deploy once.
roborock-device.selectedNoIp: Selected __name__. Click Done, set the IP (or use Find on LAN), then Deploy once.
roborock-device.selectAccount: Select a roborock account, sign in there and click Done. No deploy is needed before fetching.
roborock-device.listening: Listening on UDP 58866 for about 8 seconds...
roborock-device.nothingHeard: Nothing heard. Try again, or type the IP.
